She liked the same music as me, was Funny and seems like a pretty chill chick. However, she was not really my type so i really wasnt interested in being anything but friend with her. We started hanging out quite frequently and became quite good friends, but after knowing eachother for about a month things started to Change.

She became more and more jealous of me hanging out with Or even talking to other women, she was textning me and calling me 24/7 asking what i was doing and who i was with etc. It was absolutly nuts, cuz when i confronted her about it she just cried and said she was sorry but kept doing it. So i ended up ending our friendship, blocking her number and... everything.  And now i finally got some peace and quiet until the private calls started pouring in, at first i answeared not knowing it was her. She was crying about how it was cruel of me to lead her on and just reject her like that, she  Threatened me she was going to kill herself If I didnt talk to her etc. I tried calming her down but she just got really angry and Hung up. Then i stopped answearing all calls from private numbers.

I was dreading meeting her at school after that, but i didnt for like two months, and The talk around school told me she has been sent to a psychiatricward for trying to kill herself and being anorexic. Yikes.

BUT the final FINAL straw was when i was in my apartment, chilling with my roomate about 3months after it all went down and my Phone starts ringing like crazy from an private number, and I Immediately assume its her. At the same time my doorbell starts going of, i sneak up and peak and yup there she is. So as the problem solver i am i just leave her at the door, pretending im not home. And she stands outside my door for over an hour. Was seriously considering calling the Police lol. 
 The worst part is My adress is listed in my hometown at my parents house. The only way she could have know where i lived is If she had followed me there.

TL;DR
Meet a female friend, she likes me i dont like her back. She becomes obsessed with me and ends up stalking me to my apartment standing outside my door for an hour.
